_status: LIVE -- this is the copy ceres/bcx_cap.py reads at runtime. Edit this file to change board behavior.

_provenance.config_version_at_fetch: see version/config_version fields in raw settings.json snapshot
_provenance.cross_checked_against: ~/.praetoria/cache/collection_player0005.json (player0005's live owned cards, bcx/level per card)
_provenance.cross_check_result: exact match on every maxed specimen owned across Alpha reg/gold, Beta reg/gold, Foundations reg/gold, and modern reg/gold — see findings.md for the full table
_provenance.derivation_confirmed_via: splinterlands.com production JS bundle (assets/index-B08Ft7Mn.js, fetched 2026-08-21), functions getMaxXp/getMaxLevel/cardsToLevel/calculateCP
_provenance.note: regular (non-gold) alpha/beta/reward values include the base 1-BCX card itself (formula: ceil(max_xp / xp_per_card) + 1); gold values do not add +1 (formula: ceil(max_xp / xp_per_card), card already starts above level 1)

alpha.note: Also applies to Promo (edition 2) cards with card_detail_id < 100, per game client logic.

beta.note: Edition 3 = Reward edition, shares Beta's xp-based combine mechanism. Also applies to Promo (edition 2) cards with card_detail_id >= 100.

modern.editions: all editions >= 4 (Untamed, Dice, Gladius, Chaos, Rift, Nightmare, Soulbound, Soulkeep Promo, Rebellion, Soulbound Rebellion, Conclave, Extra, Soulbound Conclave, Land, Escalation, Verico) EXCLUDING Foundations (15) and Foundations Soulbound (16)
modern.note: Uniform table since Untamed (edition 4) onward; source field api.splinterlands.com/settings -> combine_rates / combine_rates_gold. Identical to Beta's rare/epic/legendary/gold numbers; only common differs (400 vs Beta's 505).

foundations.note: Foundations and Foundations Soulbound have their own reduced cap table and shorter max-level ladder.

soulkeep.note: tier===9 cards select sk_combine_rates/_gold in the game client, but this is the separate 'Soulkeep' card game (game_type: soulkeep), not Splinterlands. Included for completeness / to avoid misapplying this table to Splinterlands cards; NOT expected to appear on the Ceres board.
